name: MIMIC-CXR: Chest Radiographs and Radiology Reports Database
description: A large, freely available clinical database of 377,110 chest radiographs associated with 227,835 de-identified free-text radiology reports from 65,379 unique patients who attended the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center emergency department between 2011 and 2016. Radiographs are provided in DICOM and high-resolution JPEG formats with 14 clinical labels extracted by automated labelers. Safeguard notice: Access requires PhysioNet credentialing, CITI human research training certification, and a signed data use agreement prohibiting re-identification; non-diagnostic research and educational use only.
